cues.speaker: lark
cues.text: Vespera Terminal. Lane clear. You can board now.

cues.speaker: attendant
cues.text: Captain, nobody's moving. They heard that voice yesterday.

cues.speaker: lark
cues.text: You've got the channel. I'll keep the lane quiet.

cues.speaker: attendant
cues.text: It's me, from the ticket window. Back row first. Follow my flare.

cues.speaker: attendant
cues.text: Stop there. Under the awning, everyone. We'll take the covered ramp.

cues.speaker: attendant
cues.text: Last car empty, Captain. You can bring us home.
